selection_reasoning: Mining birch logs is a prerequisite for crafting a wooden sword. The player must first mine birch logs, then convert them into birch planks (for the blade material) and sticks (planks crafted into sticks for the handle). This forms a natural 2-hop Minecraft crafting progression: mine logs → process into planks/sticks → craft wooden sword. Both tasks are observable and verifiable through inventory checks.

edges.reason: Wooden sword requires birch planks and sticks, both derived from birch logs obtained by mining

milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining a birch log block drops a birch_log item that enters the player's inventory. The player starts with an empty inventory, so any birch_log present confirms successful mining. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a wooden sword produces the item directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with no wooden_sword, so its presence confirms successful crafting. All wood plank types (including birch) produce the same generic 'wooden_sword' item. This is the preferred rule type for craft tasks since the crafted item ends up in inventory.

scene_description: A cleared grass area with two birch trees (4 logs each) and a crafting table. The scene supports mining birch logs and then crafting a wooden sword using the nearby crafting table. The clearing ensures the birch trees are prominently visible and easily accessible from spawn.
task_text: Mine a birch log from one of the nearby birch trees, then use the crafting table to craft a wooden sword.
design_notes: Two birch trees provide 8 total logs (more than enough for a wooden sword which needs 1 log minimum → 4 planks → 2 planks + 2 sticks, but actually needs 2 logs: one for planks, one for sticks via planks). Crafting table at (~3,~0,~3) is adjacent to birch tree #1 at (~5,~0,~5). Second birch tree at (~-4,~0,~-3) provides backup. The /fill air command clears natural biome trees within 12 blocks to keep the scene clean.
